what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: fewer or smaller quanta reach the postsynaptic cell (lower release probability, lower GABA synthesis or vesicle filling, fewer interneurons or terminals) while postsynaptic receptors and chloride are normal.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: a normal response to a directly applied agonist under TTX together with a reduced evoked IPSC (more failures, higher paired-pulse ratio) and fewer interneuron or presynaptic-marker counts per animal; mIPSC frequency down with amplitude less changed.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: agonist response reduced in proportion to the sIPSC loss; failure rate and paired-pulse ratio unchanged; marker counts unchanged.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: sIPSC amplitude and frequency both lower (P03); interneuron firing intact except a 26 percent lower soma AP amplitude (60.78 to 45.03 mV, 5-6 cells, P04), the one measured interneuron change and one that points the supply way (INFERENZA: a smaller presynaptic spike lowers calcium entry) but does not discriminate. INFERENZA: the same values fit E-response and E-compensation. DATO (Brown 2015, PBR1): wild-type mIPSC frequency rises 2.2 to 12.9 Hz between P10 and P15 while mean amplitude is flat, so an age-related lag would more plausibly appear in event rate than in amplitude (INFERENZA; mIPSC, not sIPSC).
control_for_a_null: A null in marker counts does not exclude lost function: pair counts with evoked IPSC from the same animals; antibody and counting rules fixed on age-matched wild type; the animal is the unit.
decided_by_source_methods: no (the methods inform but do not decide; P03 P04 P05: no release or number measure)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX neocortex (P05 P14: marker deficit only in a systemic-knockout hippocampus; organoid GAD1 goes the other way)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: fewer, smaller-conductance or differently assembled postsynaptic GABA-A receptors on layer II/III pyramidal cells; release and chloride normal.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: reduced response to a fixed agonist input under TTX; reduced mIPSC amplitude with unchanged mIPSC frequency and paired-pulse ratio; altered decay kinetics pointing to a subunit change.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: agonist response and mIPSC amplitude normal (the agonist response is the test; a burst test adds nothing over it for this explanation).
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: amplitude loss at -70 mV with 140 mM KCl (P01 P03). INFERENZA: with E_Cl clamped near -2 mV the amplitude reflects receptor number, conductance and quantal size, which E-supply (filling) can also lower. DATO (PBR1): decay tau falls 12.1 to 5.4 ms across P7-P24 in wild type and a neurosteroid tone shapes it up to P15, so decay is an age-sensitive readout; the Wwox sIPSC decay is not reported.
control_for_a_null: Agonist application at a fixed distance and pipette geometry, same age and animals; input resistance and cell size recorded (Table 1 shows higher input resistance in knockouts, P04 context); a normal response does not exclude extrasynaptic or subunit-selective change.
decided_by_source_methods: no (the methods inform but do not decide; P01 P03 P05: amplitude only; no mIPSC, kinetics or agonist response)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX (P13 transcript panel: GABRB2 and GABRB3 lower in organoids, composition confounded)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: intracellular chloride is higher in knockout layer II/III cells at P13-P17 than in age-matched wild-type littermates, so E_GABA is closer to (or above) resting potential or threshold and inhibition per unit conductance is weaker. The reference matters: wild-type dendritic E_Cl in PFC is at resting potential (shunting, P08), so the contrast is genotype against wild type, not distance from rest.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: E_GABA by gramicidin perforated patch (or another method that leaves chloride to the cell) more depolarised than in age-matched wild-type littermates of the same preparation, read against resting potential and threshold in the same cells; the shift removed by an NKCC1-directed or KCC2-directed manipulation.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: E_GABA equal to age-matched wild type in the same preparation (the wild-type reference in P08 is E_Cl at resting potential, shunting, so the contrast is genotype and not distance from rest); the knockout resting potential is already 5.6 mV more depolarised in whole-cell K-gluconate recordings uncorrected for liquid junction (DATO Table 1, -79.25 against -73.62 mV: the sign holds, the absolute values do not).
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: none. INFERENZA (sharper finding): with E_Cl pinned near -2 mV by 140 mM KCl (about 129 mM extracellular Cl, verifier calculation) the driving force at -70 mV is about 68 mV in both genotypes, so a raised native postsynaptic chloride cannot lower the sIPSC amplitude through the postsynaptic driving force (in incompletely dialysed distal dendrites a raised native chloride would, if anything, enlarge the amplitude there, which strengthens the point); it does not exclude a presynaptic or interneuron chloride effect on release (P09), which this datum cannot test either: E-chloride is untested by this datum, not excluded, and has no motive in this sIPSC datum beyond the textbook premise (NEED-GABA-CHLORIDE-GRADIENT, DEFAULT_FROM_TEXTBOOK). DATO: transcript ratio SLC12A2/SLC12A5 not raised (P13) is not E_GABA.
control_for_a_null: Positive control that the method works on the same day (perforation integrity: rupture shifts E_Cl to the pipette value, as Rinetti-Vargas used it; a transporter manipulation that moves E_Cl in wild type); a null at the soma does not exclude an axon-initial-segment or distal difference (P08: AIS matures late); a null at one age does not exclude a different time course; a difference seen only in bursting slices may be secondary (see E-chloride-secondary).
decided_by_source_methods: no (no record in the source leaves chloride to the cell: the sIPSC internal is 140 mM KCl and the burst-current internal is a whole-cell pipette, K-gluconate with about 12 mM Cl by calculation or the KCl one; P07 is not an E_GABA measurement; P01 P02 P05)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no for WWOX (P13 absence; wild-type time courses only in other mouse regions and by other readouts P08 P09 P10 P11 PBR1)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: a depolarised or shunting E_GABA that is a consequence of the knockout bursting (activity-dependent chloride loading by repeated GABA-A activation), not a primary transport defect; a variant of E-compensation that also acts through the chloride route.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: E_GABA shifted in knockout slices that burst and in wild-type slices driven into bursts (M09 reading E_GABA), absent at an age or in slices before bursting begins.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: E_GABA shifted in knockouts before bursts or not shifted in driven wild type.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: 36 of 42 knockout slices burst, 0 of 11 wild-type (Results 2.1), so a burst-free knockout contrast is hard to obtain inside the source. A depolarised E_GABA in bursting knockout tissue is compatible with primary and secondary causes.
control_for_a_null: Driven wild-type bursts with E_GABA read in the same slices (M09), matched in burst rate and measured bath conditions; the age series (M02) for onset of the change relative to onset of bursting.
decided_by_source_methods: no (P05: no E_GABA; no pre-burst age)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the sIPSC change is secondary to the knockout network own hyperactivity or bursting, for example a tonic inhibition change or an activity-dependent change in synaptic inhibition, and would appear in a wild-type slice driven into similar activity.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: a gabazine-sensitive tonic current changed in knockouts under a fixed ambient-GABA and uptake condition; wild-type slices driven into bursting show a similar sIPSC change; an age before bursting begins shows normal sIPSC.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: sIPSC already reduced at an age or in slices without bursts; tonic current unchanged; wild-type slices in a burst state keep normal sIPSC.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: bursts are present in 36 of 42 knockout slices (86 percent) and 4 of 23 heterozygote slices against 0 of 11 wild type (Results 2.1), so a burst-free knockout contrast is hard to obtain inside this paper. INFERENZA: a reduced sIPSC in a bursting slice fits both cause and consequence.
control_for_a_null: Tonic current depends on ambient GABA and uptake state (P12: 170 against 12 pA with added GABA; 9 against 41 pA with uptake blocked, on clamped high-chloride internals in layer 5): fix and report the condition; gabazine alone as its own control; a youngest-age series is limited by the survival window (P06).
decided_by_source_methods: no (P05 P12: tonic not measured; no age before bursting)
resolvable_from_public_sources: partly (P12 gives the relative age pattern of tonic current in mouse S1 layer 5, not P13-P17 and not layer II/III; not a baseline for Wwox)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the knockout differs from wild type because the developmental time course of synaptic inhibition or of the chloride switch is shifted or compressed, so a P13-P17 comparison catches a moment on the curve (the authors own caution, P06, made about a drug effect at an earlier stage). The six rows are not a partition: a delay in supply, response or chloride is still supply, response or chloride, so E-maturation is a modifier of the others, not a rival to them. An age series can show a constant offset against a shifted time course; it cannot show that a defect is correctable, which is a property of an intervention.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: an age series of knockout, heterozygote and wild-type littermates in which the knockout curve of sIPSC, E_GABA or KCC2 lags or leads the wild-type curve and the difference changes with age.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: a difference of constant sign and similar size at every age sampled, including ages where the wild-type curve is flat (for amplitude the wild-type mIPSC curve is flat over P7-P24, PBR1).
compatible_but_not_discriminating: INFERENZA (a synthesis across regions, methods and two abstract-only sources, not a measurement): reported wild-type timetables of the chloride switch run from about P9-P14 to P15-P21 (P08 P09 P10; P11 in vivo early inhibitory). DATO: KCC2 protein, KCC2 phosphorylation (lowest at P13-P15) and axon-initial-segment E_Cl are not settled at P13-P17 (P08) and the Karst switch is P15-P21 (P09, abstract), whereas dendritic E_Cl in P08 is constant from P14. DATO (PBR1): in wild-type layer 2/3, mIPSC frequency and decay change steeply across P10-P15 and amplitude does not.
control_for_a_null: The age window is bounded by survival (P06): a lack of catch-up cannot be read at ages the knockouts do not reach; add a survivor-selection control (littermates and survivors at the oldest ages compared with the same animals earlier, or measures of the animals that die versus survive where feasible); wild-type littermates at each age as reference; a null at two ages does not describe the curve.
decided_by_source_methods: no (P06: single age window, no wild-type curve in the paper)
resolvable_from_public_sources: partly (wild-type time courses exist in mouse: layer 2/3 mIPSC frequency, decay and amplitude P7-P24 in PBR1, the evoked IPSC maturation of mouse visual cortex layer 2/3 in the abstract of 20962247 (not opened beyond the abstract by me or the verifier) and, by other readouts, PFC, S1 and visual cortex P08 P09 P10 P11 P12; none gives sIPSC, E_GABA and KCC2 together in the Wwox preparation at P13-P17)

what_it_predicts_in_the_wwox_model: IPOTESI: the halving is produced or inflated by recording conditions or analysis: excitatory events not blocked at -70 mV in KCl, a detection threshold relative to noise, access-resistance differences, event-level statistics on few animals.
favouring_observation: INFERENZA: the difference disappears or shrinks when sIPSCs are re-recorded with glutamate-receptor block, a fixed absolute threshold and per-animal summary.
weakening_outcome: INFERENZA: the difference persists at similar size under those controls. INFERENZA: the higher knockout input resistance (143 against 103 Mohm, Table 1) would, through better space clamp, favour larger and not smaller recorded knockout amplitudes, which argues against a clamp artefact for the amplitude loss.
compatible_but_not_discriminating: DATO: the difference is large on every pooled-event display (Fig 4H-h1 viewed). DATO: no glutamate-receptor block is named for the sIPSC series, and at -70 mV in KCl excitatory events are also inward; the knockout sIPSC mean (27.5 pA) lies close to the sEPSC mean (24.7 pA) and S-CTL sIPSC and sEPSC frequencies are close (10.3 and 9.9 Hz): INFERENZA, suggestive of overlap but not showing contamination. DATO: the 4 x SD detection threshold (Methods 6.5) makes counted frequency amplitude-dependent, so lower amplitude and lower frequency are not two independent findings; the frequency metric is not declared. The repository record that 10 of 18 reported p values lie below an event-level floor (NEED-INHIBITORY-HYPOFUNCTION O1) is cited by id and was not re-derived or verified here.
control_for_a_null: Per-animal summaries with a mixed model (cells nested in animals, litter noted); access resistance and noise reported per genotype; a rerun by a person blind to genotype; a null only means the artefact is not the whole effect.
decided_by_source_methods: no (the methods inform but do not decide; P01 P02 P03: conditions and unit are declared or undeclared, their effect on amplitude is not measured)
resolvable_from_public_sources: no (needs the recordings, not available as data: P13 queries)
